method: Offline WAV high-frequency onset proposals, high-frequency variance-change refinement for pairs, and assistant visual review of all waveforms/spectrograms against ST7 r1/r10 references; no model inference or training
limitation: This interface cannot listen to audio. Labels are visual/signal-analysis drafts, not validated human ground truth. Review before training.
